newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur has no comment on Belgian Josi.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur has no comment on Belgian Josi.

text.p: Winterthur Insurance Co declined to comment on a newspaper report it would acquire Belgian family-controlled insurer Josi.
Winterthur would say only that it would hold a news conference in Brussels on Monday, November 18.
"I cannot confirm or deny it," Winterthur spokeswoman Anna-Marie Kappeler said when asked about the report of a merger.
The Belgian newspaper L'Echo said on Thursday that Winterthur Europe, a unit of the Swiss group, would merge its activities with those of Josi.
Josi is 47 percent held by Belgium's Cie Benelux Paribas (Cobepa).
L'Echo said details of the deal would be announced on November 18 -- the day Winterthur has scheduled its news conference.
Kappeler said Winterthur would talk to the media on Monday in a Brussels hotel.
But she declined to say whether any representatives of Josi would be attending.
